name: Opt in — no scheme named (NPS vs VPF)
goal: When the user says 'opt in' without naming NPS or VPF, the bot must ask WHICH scheme to opt in to — not silently assume one and not dead-end.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified / ambiguous user intent. The bot should ask a clarifying question and route correctly, never guess.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot treats the opt-in request as unclear and asks which scheme — NPS or VPF — the user wants to opt in to; it does NOT assume one or jump straight into a single flow.
